run_compare_tensor_dumps: run tensor dump comparison between baseline and target directories with optional token alignment
run_compare_with_visualization: run tensor dump comparison and generate per-token heatmap PNG for visualizing differences
run_compare_with_dims_override: run tensor dump comparison with overridden dimension annotations for baseline and target tensors
run_compare_with_filter_pattern: run tensor dump comparison filtering target tensors by filename regex pattern
run_compare_with_preset_config: run tensor dump comparison using a named preset configuration for common comparison settings
